scripts.text:
[Rina]
Hi~!
You are an adventurer like me.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你好~！
你和我一样，也是一名冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I am put under a curse.
I know you want to help me,
but your experience is not enough.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
我中了诅咒。
我知道你想帮忙，可你的冒险经验还不够。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I am not in the good condition,
so what I can do for you
is just like this.
Then, good bye.
Take care~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
我现在状态不太好，能帮你的只有这些了。
再见，保重~！

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Hi~!
You are an adventurer like me.
Well... In fact, I am
put under a strange curse.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你好~！你和我一样，也是冒险者。
嗯...其实，我中了一个奇怪的诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
To release this curse,
somebody needs to do ^800080Oath-taking ceremony^000000
with me,
and then needs to solve
several problems instead of me.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
要解除诅咒，需要有人和我一起进行^800080宣誓仪式^000000，再代替我完成几项任务。

scripts.text: Let's help ^800080Rina^000000.
Just skip it.
scripts.translation: 不管了

scripts.text:
[Rina]
To help me,
I need a competent adventurer.
If you know those people,
I hope you to introduce them to me later.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
我需要一位有能力的冒险者帮忙。
要是你认识这样的人，希望能介绍给我。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Are you really going to help me?
Thank you.
You are so brave.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你真的要帮我吗？
谢谢你。
你真勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Then I'll start ^800080Oath-taking ceremony^000000.
 
^787878( A mysterious atmosphere hangs in the air. )^000000
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
那么我开始^800080宣誓仪式^000000了。
 
^787878（空气中弥漫着神秘的氛围。）^000000

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Blah blah blah...
 
Blah blah blah...
 
^787878( ... This is a strange spell. )^000000
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
Blah blah blah...
 
Blah blah blah...
 
^787878（...这咒语真奇怪。）^000000

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Haaaaah~
^800080Oath-taking ceremony^000000 is done enough now.
Isn't that so simple?
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
Haaaaah~
^800080宣誓仪式^000000完成了。
是不是很简单？

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Okay, from no on,
you need to go on ^006400a real adventure
to release my curse^000000.
Let me know when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
接下来，你要^006400踏上真正的冒险，解除我的诅咒^000000。
准备好了就告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
What you need to do is
to choose one monster among
^FF0000DEVIRUCHI,^000000 ^FF0000WRAITH DEAD,^000000
^FF0000DULLAHAN,^000000 ^FF0000NIGHTMARE TERROR^000000
and then kill ^0000FF50^000000 monsters
and come back to me.

[Rina]
It must be a tough task,
but you are the right person
who did the oath-taking ceremony.
I hope you succeed.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
任务一定很艰难，但既然完成了宣誓仪式，你就是合适的人选。
希望你能成功。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
You did it.
I can feel that my body is recovering.
But it is not enough.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你做到了。
我能感觉到我的身体正在恢复。
但还不够。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
^006400You have one more thing to do.^000000
Let me know when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
^006400你还有一件事要做。^000000
准备好了就告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I will check one thing.
For this task,
You need to feel the music.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
先确认一件事。
这个任务需要你能听到音乐。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
You cannot complete the task
without the music.
do you have any problem?
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
听不到音乐就没法完成任务。
你这边没问题吧？

scripts.text:
- Check! -
^787878- BGM option should be turned on -^000000
^787878- in the game option menu. -^000000
^787878- Please check -^000000
^787878- whether you can listen -^000000
^787878- to the music sound. -^000000
[I'm ready to listen to the BGM.]
scripts.translation: [准备好听背景音乐了]

scripts.text: [I can't listen to the BGM.]
scripts.translation: [听不到背景音乐]

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I am so shocked that
you cannot feel the music.
What should we do now...
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
竟然听不到音乐，我真没想到。
这下怎么办呢...

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Listen carefully
the feelings of it...
I can't hear it,
but you can hear the sound.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
仔细听，感受这段音乐...
我听不见，但你能听到。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
^006400The music you're hearing now^000000
has something to do with the one specific city.
Think carefully ^006400what kind of city^000000
has similar feeling with this music.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
^006400你现在听到的音乐^000000，与某座城市有关。
仔细想想，^006400是哪座城市^000000的氛围和这段音乐相似。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
And...
Go to ^006400the city
where you can remind by this music^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
然后...前往^006400这段音乐让你想到的那座城市^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
After that,
find ^FF0000the strange mark^000000
around the entrances of the city.
Then you can release the curse on me.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
到那里后，在城市入口附近寻找^FF0000奇怪的标记^000000。
这样就能解除我的诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
It must be tough
but I hope you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
任务一定不容易，祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
You're back~!
My curse has been released.
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你回来了~！
我的诅咒已经解除了。
非常感谢你。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Your bag is too full.
I have a present for you
so make your bag lighter.
I'll wait for you.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你的背包太满了。
我有礼物送你，先减轻些负重吧。
我等你。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
This is the present for you.
It's not a big one
but please take it
as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
这是给你的礼物。
虽然不贵重，还是请收下，表达我的一点谢意。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I'll take a rest for a few days
and then I'll go on an adventure.
See you again.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
我歇几天，就继续去冒险。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Thank you for releasing my curse.
I'll take a rest for a few days
and then go on an adventure again.
Have a happy day~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
谢谢你解除了我的诅咒。
歇几天后，我就继续去冒险。
祝你今天愉快~！

scripts.text: - I found ^0000FFthe strange mark^000000. -
scripts.translation: - 我找到了^0000FF奇怪的标记^000000。 -

scripts.text:
- I can definitely feel that
- ^0000FFRina^000000 has been released
- from the curse.
- ^006400Let's go back to Rina!^000000
scripts.translation:
- 我能清楚地感觉到，
- ^0000FF莉娜^000000已经摆脱了诅咒。
- ^006400回去找莉娜吧！^000000

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
.......
 
^787878( No response. )^000000

[Rina's Little Friend]
Hi.
I guess you're the trustworthy friend.
Are you here to make a deal with me?
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
你好。
我想你就是那个值得信赖的朋友。
你是来和我做交易的吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text: What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Hmm.
The material is not enough.
Please check the things you need.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
嗯，材料不够。
再检查一下需要的东西吧。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Cool... if you give me the materials
I will start it right now.
Are you ready for it?
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
好...把材料给我，我就开始。
准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, let's start it.
scripts.translation: 好，开始吧

scripts.text: No, stop it.
scripts.translation: 不，停下

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Heh. It's boring.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
呵。真无聊。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Okay, I will start it now.
 
^787878( A mysterious atmosphere hangs in the air. )^000000
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
好，现在开始。
 
^787878（空气中弥漫着神秘的氛围。）^000000

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Life is given to the egg.
Aaaaah~ I got to take some rest.
Good bye~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
这枚蛋已经获得生命了。
Aaaaah~我得歇一歇。
再见~！

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
It seems that you have quite interesting things.
I need to take some rest.
Good bye~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
看来你有一些挺有趣的东西。
我得休息一下了。
再见~！

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
There was no change.
I didn't mean to do it,
but I'm sorry...
I hope to see you again, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
什么变化都没有。
虽然不是故意的，还是对不起...
希望还能见到你，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Hmm.
It became a dish.
Looks delicious.
Then, good bye~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
嗯，变成一道菜了。
看起来挺好吃。
再见~！

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
You are here just to see my cute looks?
Aren't you peeking at Rina
pretending to see me?
It's funny... haha~
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
你只是来看我可爱的模样？
该不会假装来看我，其实在偷看莉娜吧？
真有意思...haha~

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Huh?!
I never told you before?
Then listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
咦？！
我之前没告诉过你吗？
那你仔细听好了。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
I have a
special ability.
It's to give a special strength
to ^0000FFthe egg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
我有一种特殊能力，能赋予^0000FF蛋^000000特别的力量。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Well, I cannot do that unlimitedly.
There is no magic that is done forever.
So I need some additional cost.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
不过，这种能力可不能没完没了地用。
魔法总有极限，所以还需要额外的费用。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
And I cannot sure
to what the egg will be changed.
It may be end in failure
and it can be something like Pet Egg.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
我也不能保证蛋会变成什么。
可能失败，也可能变成宠物蛋之类的东西。

scripts.text: Ask the cost.
scripts.translation: 询问费用

scripts.text: Stop listening because it feels like a trick.
scripts.translation: 像是骗局，不听了

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Well... I don't really care.
Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
嗯... 我其实不太在意。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Do you want to make a deal?
You need
^0000FF1 Egg^000000, ^0000FF20 Light Granule^000000 and
^B8860B400,000 Zeny.

[Rina's Little Friend]
Do you want to make a deal?
You need
^0000FF1 Egg^000000, ^0000FF20 Light Granule^000000 and
^B8860B450,000 Zeny^000000.

[Rina's Little Friend]
Do you want to make a deal?
You need
^0000FF1 Egg^000000, ^0000FF20 Light Granule^000000 and
^B8860B480,000 Zeny^000000.

[Rina's Little Friend]
Do you want to make a deal?
You need
^0000FF1 Egg^000000, ^0000FF20 Light Granule^000000 and
^B8860B500,000 Zeny^000000.

[Rina's Little Friend]
If you are interested
make that zeny and come again.
Haha...
I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
感兴趣的话，凑够Zeny再来吧。
Haha...
我等着你。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Ahem!
Why? Are you surprised to see me speaking?
Well, I understand you.
Only the person who did
the oath-taking ceremony can talk with me.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
咳！怎么，我会说话让你很惊讶？
可以理解，只有参加过宣誓仪式的人，才能跟我说话。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
If Rina's curse is released,
I can also
suggest you
an interesting thing.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
等莉娜的诅咒解除了，我还能告诉你一件有趣的事。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
I will let you know
the detailed explanation later.
Then see you later, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
详细的事以后再说。
回头见，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
I'm a traveler
and I often visit ^8B4513Prontera^000000.
Hmm, I think I might
see you around here before.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我是个旅行者，经常来^8B4513普隆德拉^000000。
嗯...以前好像在这里见过你。

scripts.text: Listen some more.
scripts.translation: 再听一会儿

scripts.text: Just ignore it.
scripts.translation: 直接无视

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
As I expected,
you are a silent person. Ha ha.
Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
果然不爱说话啊，哈哈。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
A few days ago,
I saw a new adventurer
who were standing
near the ^8B4513Cathedral^000000.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
几天前，我看到一位新来的冒险者，站在^8B4513大教堂^000000附近。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
That adventurer seemed pretty.
But...
I feel some strange energy
so I don't come close to that person.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那位冒险者挺漂亮。
可我感觉到一股奇怪的力量，就没敢靠近。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Look like
you're interested in
that new adventurer?
Or that is just your face look. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
你似乎对那位新来的冒险者很感兴趣？
还是你平时就是这副表情？哈哈。

scripts.text: I'm interested in it.
scripts.translation: 我对此很感兴趣

scripts.text: I don't care at all.
scripts.translation: 我完全不在乎

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Ah~ I see~!
Then, Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
啊~ 原来如此~！
那么，再见。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Just as I expected!
You can find
that new adventurer
on the way to the ^8B4513Cathedral^000000
at the direction of 1o'clock in ^8B4513Prontera^000000.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
果然！
往^8B4513大教堂^000000走，就能找到那位新来的冒险者。
就在^8B4513普隆德拉^0000001点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
She was carrying
^800080a big egg thing^000000.
That's what I know.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
她抱着^800080一个大大的蛋状物^000000。
我知道的就这些。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
A while ago,
I met a lady
and she said she has been
under a strange curse.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
不久前，我遇到一位女士，她说自己中了奇怪的诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
I wanted to help her
but my experience is not enough.
So I couldn't help her.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我本想帮她，可冒险经验还不够，没能帮上忙。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
If you are more than
level ^0000FF40^000000,
go to the ^8B4513Cathedral^000000
at the direction of 1'o clock.
I hope you can help her...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
如果你超过^0000FF40^000000级，就去1点钟方向的^8B4513大教堂^000000吧。
希望你能帮到她...
